reviews.text: I recently purchased a necklace from PC Chandra and I am absolutely thrilled with it! The design is even more beautiful in person than it looked online, and the quality of the materials is exceptional. The customer service was also outstanding. BIKASH Matty was incredibly helpful and patient, answering all my questions and making the whole experience enjoyable. I highly recommend PC Chandra for anyone looking for beautiful, high-quality jewelry and excellent service

Excellent service, Aditi was really helpful and patient . Branch have excellent design and collection of gold jewelry. Absolutely stunning collection and top-notch service! The staff (Aditi) were incredibly helpful, and the designs were both traditional and modern. I found exactly what I was looking for. Highly recommend this showroom for anyone looking for quality and elegance!

We visited PC Chandra, Noida sector 18 store. It was a good experience and received excellent service by Samrat Banerjee. He was polite and showed multiple options. He gave us enough time to make our choice. He made sure that we were happy and satisfied with our purchase.

My experience with PC Chandra Noida branch has always been an excellent one. Saheli is too good and helpful in selecting the desired jewellery. I definitely recommend every one to visit the Noida store and buy some beautiful pieces for self.
